LESSON: READING READINESS SKILLS

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Book handling By the end of the sub-strand, the • Learners could be engaged in a
Topic 3.2: Reading readiness skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reading readiness skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when (2HRS) a) Demonstrate left-right eye and drop from left to right in a digital clip. reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reading readiness skills

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Reading readiness skills

Teach
• Focus skill: Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Reading readiness skills.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Reading readiness skills
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when (2HRS) a) Demonstrate left-right eye and drop from left to right in a digital clip. reading?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
